title: Zesty Xinjiang Lamb Burger
description: A flavorful and spicy Xinjiang style lamb burger served in a mini cocotte with sesame seed burger buns, featuring a blend of Chinese and Middle Eastern flavors, kosher friendly and perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the lamb mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a patty about 3/4 inch thick.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and sear the lamb patties for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the patties to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the sesame seed burger buns by baking them in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a tablespoon of soy sauce on the bottom bun, followed by a lamb patty, a few slices of onion, and finally the top bun.
Serve the burgers in individual mini cocottes and enjoy immediately.
